source: QED 4-loop photon self-energy — TwoBubbles topology — staged mass1 variant: only propagator D1 = l1^2 carries mass me^2; the 7 other originally-electron propagators (D2, D3, D5, D6, D7, D8, D11) are made massless. The 3 photon propagators (D4, D9, D10) remain massless. ISPs are D12-D14 = (p1+l2)^2, (p1+l4)^2, (l1+l3)^2. Kinematics: p1^2 = 0 (on-shell photon ext), me^2 = 1, eps = 1/1000. dot = 5, rank = 0.
notes: C++ amflow_cli FAILED on this case at the eta-flow stage (Kira rc=1). The failure is caused by the C++ branch-mode tie-breaker placing eta on a massless propagator (D3=l2^2), whereas MMA places eta on the massive D1=l1^2-msq. The placement difference is documented in notes/future_optimization_proposals.md.
